description: This file defines a React-like component for the Tic Tac Toe game UI using the Qwik framework. It manages game state, handles user interactions such as starting a new game and making moves, and renders the game interface including the board and controls.

methods.name: startNewGame
methods.description: Initializes a new game by invoking the startGame API and updating the state with the game details.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on the game board, executes a move via API, and updates the game state accordingly.
